document.title: Summary of Benefits 2027, UPMC for Life PPO Rx Choice (PPO), Allegheny County
document.url_source: The "PPO Rx Choice - Allegheny" Summary of Benefits link on https://www.upmchealthplan.com/medicare-brokers/medicare/2027-upmc-for-life-plans; the plan's page on Medicare Plan Finder does not link the document
document.retrieval_note: The maintainer downloaded it in a browser on 2026-10-27. The host's robots.txt (https://upmc.widen.net/robots.txt, read 2026-10-27) disallows every path for automated fetching, which this check did not do.
document.read_with: pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw, both with -enc UTF-8; pages counted in the PDF, which are the printed page numbers plus 1 (the cover is unnumbered). The benefit chart's columns are "In-Network (IN)" and "Out-of-Network (OUT)"; the -layout output interleaves them on pages 4 to 7, so values were read from the -raw output, which prints each row's in-network value before its out-of-network one. Part D on pages 10 and 11; only the Part D deductible is checked.

checks.printed: $33 per month
checks.note: The file gives pbp_d_mplusc_premium "5.00" (Plan Premium Amount (A/B)), the medical part of the premium, which the document holds (spec 4.1). The $33 the Summary of Benefits prints is the total; Medicare Plan Finder (plan details 2027-H5533-019-0, read 2026-10-27) shows Health premium $5.00 and Drug premium $28.00. The Part D premium is in no column of the PBP Benefits files: a value the file does not state.

checks.note: The file states the allowance in Section D, as a combined supplemental benefit group: pbp_d_combo_grp_name_1 "Flex Spend Card - OTC/HSD", pbp_d_combo_nmc_cats_1 "13b;14c8;", pbp_d_combo_max_plan_ben_yn_1 "1", pbp_d_combo_max_plan_ben_amt_1 "20.00", pbp_d_combo_max_plan_period_1 "5"; 13b itself answers pbp_b13b_maxplan_yn "2". Until 2026-10-28 the Medicare Advantage importer did not read the pbp_d_combo_ columns, and this check was a difference; since then it writes the allowance with shared_limit_id PBP_D_COMBO_1 (docs/specs/pbp-importer.md section 5.9). The sentence on rolling over is the next check.

checks.printed: These allowances do not roll over from quarter to quarter
checks.note: Split from the allowance check on 2026-10-28. No combined supplemental benefit group column states a carryover, and 13b's own pbp_b13b_maxplan_prd_yn is blank because 13b answers pbp_b13b_maxplan_yn "2", so the limit has no carryover (docs/specs/pbp-importer.md section 5.9).

Addresses are compared with the scheme, a leading "www." and the case of the host ignored, so the printed address is written here in the document's form; the printed one has no closing slash and on 2026-10-27 answered with 1 redirect at the filed address.

checks.printed: To search for your providers in our network, visit upmchealthplan.com/find.
checks.note: A contradiction on a link, not a cost share. The file gives pbp_a_phys_web_addr "https://findcare.upmchealthplan.com/browse?caretype=Medical", which the document holds; the 2 differ in host and path. On 2026-10-27 both resolved to the same provider search: the printed address answered HTTP 200 after 5 redirects at https://findcare.upmchealthplan.com/, and the filed one HTTP 200 with no redirect.
